g.text: 100 robots · six procedural confirmation sites · two paired packet seeds · 80 seconds per run
Observed means shown. Registered qualification also applies conservative endpoint-pending bounds, multiplicity correction,
silence/worst-decile/video/bulk margins, timing and exact-replay checks. Full comparison matrices and intervals are in report.json.
Managed-source monitoring, AP-assisted carrier sense and slot-average PHY are simulator assumptions.
No physical-car, JEPA-superiority, SOTA or production-readiness claim.
